cim: NY Attorney General James announces new unit to oversee AI safety and enforcement
cim_eredeti: NY Attorney General James announces new unit to oversee AI safety and enforcement
szoveg_eredeti:
New York (WRGB) — New York Attorney General Letitia James announced Tuesday the creation of a new unit aimed at protecting New Yorkers from potential risks associated with artificial intelligence (AI) and other emerging technologies.

The AI Safety, Standards, Enforcement, and Transparency (ASSET) Unit will focus on enforcing AI safety laws, protecting consumer privacy and addressing potential threats involving cybersecurity, digital scams and online safety.

The unit will also oversee enforcement of New York’s Responsible AI Safety Education (RAISE) Act, which takes effect Jan. 1, 2027.

The law requires developers of certain advanced AI models to publicly disclose their safety measures and promptly report security and safety incidents.

According to the Attorney General’s Office, the new unit will also develop policy proposals and provide technical expertise to support investigations across the agency.

The initiative builds on existing efforts to address AI-related risks, including scams involving AI-generated celebrity impersonations and potentially harmful chatbot interactions.

Cristy Phillips, who previously served as special counsel for the Economic Justice Division, will lead the unit.
